text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's getting pretty hyped thanks to
the drinks, don'tcha think?!
Let's keep this hype train rolling!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right! Hmm, to do that,
it'd be great if we could hand them out
more efficiently, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, are we in a pinch~?
Mind letting this little info broker join
in the fun?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, it's Tra-poyo! Count me in, count me
in~~☆
What's the deal? You gonna act like some
kinda messiah for us?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, ya see, heard Helio was in a pinch~.
Got a lil' tip-off about it, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
A messiah, or rather, the perfect
helper... I've got just the person in
mind.
Well then, leave this one to Trapoyo~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey everyone~! Thanks for coming today~♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aah... For all of you suffering from the
heat... w-we're...
Ugh, come on! We're handin' out summer
fatigue-busting drinks, damn it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's a flavor that'll "guarantee you
perking right up☆,"
so please give it a try! ♡

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendee
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a drink?
If Falco-chan and the others are hyping it
up that much, maybe I'll give it a try...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Showing our stuff here will
get our energy flowing perfectly☆
Let's keep this momentum going, Falco-san,
Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, geez, why am I doing this...!
I'm telling you, I'm totally not cut out
for this stuff!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Eh~? I really don't think that's true at
all, but...—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
"......Hey, hey, Big Sis. If we give this
juice
to Mom, will it make her feel better?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...What's up, Mom? Feeling under the
weather?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's so hot, and they're tired.
But they're bearing with it
just because I said I wanted to see the
concert...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch. ...The tents are over here, hey!
Drag your feet and I'm leavin' ya behind!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go. Please enjoy the anti-heat
fatigue drink, yeah~âª

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'm Furioso, representing Funabashi.
Please have some of this summer
fatigue-busting drink."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"......As expected of Furioso-san.
Never missing a beat when it comes to
promoting Funabashi."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. This time, I am merely helping out to
promote Funabashi to all the festival
attendees. Merely...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Here is your Summer Fatigue
Buster Drink—please be careful
not to spill it... Fufu, please go enjoy
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
――Let's see, where were we...
Right, it's merely a side gig. I'm just
helping out while promoting Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so...? Well then, I'm
Tarumae,
the local idol of Tomakomai♪ Here's your
drink, ya hear~~☆

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Drawing crowds with Umadol charisma and
feng shui power, handed out by local
idols...
Talk about the ultimate helpers! And look,
it's a huge hit!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Heheh. ...Phew, thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"You're all smiles, Tran-san.
Did something fun happen?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, it really hits me how nice everyone
is...
I just asked for a tiny favor, and they
jumped right in to help without a second
thought.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... If we're talking about that,
Tran-san,
you're a truly kind person yourself, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...It is just as Acute-san says.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
For the festival, for the audience...
Running around the venue in this scorching
heat gathering helpers—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
After seeing you like that...
...as expected, I simply cannot turn you
away.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Truly, truly.
Tran-san is working so~ very hard, after
all—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure everyone was more than happy to
help because it was you who asked,
Tran-san.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Woah woah woah, you're laying it on way
too thick...
All I did was get some intel and poke my
nose in, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
――Hey! Switch with me on promo duty
already, dammit!
I knew this kinda stuff wasn't for me!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, alrighty~ Time to tag out~
My turn to go... Well then!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"What's Tran doing running around all over
the place again...
Good grief, she's way too nice for her own
good."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's true♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Tra-poyo, Es-pi, Oso-chi, too...
Wait, isn't the
whole helper crew maxed out on kindness~?
Total love & peace, I love it☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
